description: Entities that can own parts of the tree.

added.Entity: Class. new Entity(record) where record is { id, type, name, scheme, publicKey }. Entity.create(id, name, scheme = 'Ed25519') makes one with a new key pair. Entity.from(record) makes the right class from record.type. .record() is the public info (no privateKey). .sign(text) and .verify(text, signature) are async.
added.User: Class. An Entity for a person.
added.Population: Class. An Entity for a group; its members are listed under 'members' in its own branch. One key pair for now.
